business_problem: RELEX needed to help retailers plan promotions faster and more accurately by turning complex retail data and forecasting models into an interactive, AI-assisted optimization workflow instead of a slow manual planning exercise.
solution_summary: RELEX built its promotion-optimization stack on Google Cloud by combining large-scale retail data processing with Vertex AI and Gemini-powered agents. Cloud Storage ingests transaction histories, inventory levels, and promotional calendars, while BigQuery serves as the central data platform and Dataflow handles specialized large-scale transformations. Forecasting models that had previously lived in a more manual environment were migrated to Vertex AI so the team could manage versioning, performance monitoring, and the broader MLOps lifecycle in one place. On top of that foundation, RELEX is building a Gemini-based agent orchestrated through Google Kubernetes Engine that lets retailers interact with campaign and demand data in natural language, effectively creating a pocket pricing consultant that can turn analytics into immediate action. The platform reduces campaign-management effort from hours to minutes while improving the recommendation engine that drives retail promotions.

data_flow: Retail transaction, inventory, and promotion data lands in Cloud Storage and BigQuery, where Dataflow and forecasting models on Vertex AI process it. Gemini agents on GKE then turn those insights into natural-language planning guidance and promotional actions for retailers.
